description_en: Queries the information of a specified change set. You can choose whether to retrieve the corresponding template details
description_zh: 查询指定更改集信息，可以选择是否获取对应模板详情
name: GetChangeSet

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retrieve the template. Valid values:

true: Retrieves the template.
false (default): Does not retrieve the template
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取模板，取值：

true：获取模板。
false（默认值）：不获取模板
parameters.name: show_template

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the change set. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 更改集所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

ChangeSetName.description_en: The name of the change set

ChangeSetType.description_en: The type of the change set

Changes.description_en: The changes of the change set

items.description_en:
The changes of the change set.

For more information, see [Change set data structure]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155988.html）
items.description_zh:
更改集变更内容列表。

更多信息，请参见[更改集数据结构]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155988.html）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the change set was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format, based on the ISO 8601 standard
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

Description.description_en: The description of the change set

DisableRollback.description_en: Indicates whether to disable rollback when the stack fails to be created or updated
DisableRollback.description_zh: 资源栈在创建或更新失败时是否回滚

ExecutionStatus.description_en: The execution status of the change set

Log.description_en: The output logs of the change set

TerraformLogs.description_en:
The Terraform output logs. This parameter is returned only for change sets of Terraform stacks.

This parameter is not returned for change sets that are being created. This parameter indicates the logs generated during the creation of the change set
TerraformLogs.description_zh:
Terraform输出日志。仅Terraform类型资源栈的更改集返回该参数。

创建中的更改集不返回该参数。该参数表示创建更改集的日志

Command.description_en:
The name of the Terraform command that is run. Valid values:

apply

plan

destroy

version

For more information about the commands, see Command (https://www.terraform.io/cli/commands)
Command.description_zh:
执行的Terraform命令名称。取值：

apply

plan

destroy

version

关于命令含义的更多信息，请参见Command (https://www.terraform.io/cli/commands)

Content.description_en: The content that is output by the current command in the current output stream
Content.description_zh: 当前命令在当前输出流中输出的内容
Content.example: Apply complete! Resources: 42 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.

Stream.description_en:
The output stream. Valid values:

stdout: standard output.

stderr: standard error
Stream.description_zh:
输出流。取值：

stdout：标准输出。

stderr：标准错误

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The resource group ID.  
For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html）
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
资源组ID。  
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[什么是资源组]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html）

StackId.description_en: The ID of the stack to which the change set belongs

StackName.description_en: The name of the stack to which the change set belongs

Status.description_en: The status of the change set

StatusReason.description_en: The reason why the change set is in its current status

Tags.description_en: The tags of the change set

items.description_en: The tags of the change set

TemplateBody.description_en:
The template of the change set.

This parameter is valid only when ShowTemplate is set to true
TemplateBody.description_zh:
更改集对应的模板。

当ShowTemplate为true时该参数有效

TimeoutInMinutes.description_en: The timeout period for creating or updating the stack. Unit: minutes
TimeoutInMinutes.description_zh: 资源栈创建或更新超时时间，单位为分钟
